title: イングリッシュトピックス３
subtitle: English Topics 3
educationalGoal: In English Topics 3, students will acquire English communication skills by studying various topics, English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. They will gain confidence in speaking, listening and reading and improve their fluency and accuracy.
advice:
Students will practice speaking, listening, and reading English using daily topics from the textbook. The targeted achievement level is CEFR A2+ to B1. Students will improve their English proficiency by balancing input and output activities.

Before class, students have to study the materials from the textbook using the pre-class assignments. In class, students will ask questions to their teacher and engage in pair work and group work to further deepen their skills and knowledge. They need to look up the words that they do not know in the textbook and assignments beforehand.
Message to students: On Week 1, please bring the textbook and your PC. If possible, please bring either a paper or electronic dictionary.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary is necessary (Please refer to Royal English Grammar or Sogo Eigo Forest).

activityGoals.body: Students can use expressions and vocabulary about given topics to carry out a conversation or dicussion.
Students can carry out conversations and discussions about given topics.
Students will comprehend a short story or a conversation about given topics.
Students will comprehend multi-paragraph texts utilizing knowledge of vocabulary and grammar.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Vocabulary: Expand the vocabulary from basic-level words to more advanced-level words.
Speaking: Carry out conversations and discussions with classmates using daily topics fluently, utilizing and applying the knowledge of learned vocabulary and expressions.
Listening: Grasp the overall meaning of short stories and daily conversations about given topics accurately.
Reading: Students can comprehend multi-paragraph texts accurately by utilizing their knowledge of grammatical structure and vocabulary.
achievementLevels.standard:
Vocabulary: Know the part of speech, pronunciation, and usage of words used in each unit.
Speaking: Carry out conversations and discussions using daily topics, utilizing learned vocabulary and expressions.
Listening: Grasp the overall meaning of short stories and daily conversations about given topics to some extent.
Reading: Students can comprehend the text to some extent by utilizing their knowledge of grammatical structure and vocabulary.
